## BackToTop.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `threshold` :: How far the page must be scrolled, in pixels, before the button appears.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the button.
- `size` :: The control height; the button is always square.
- `ringSize` :: The diameter of the progress ring, which is drawn larger than the button by default.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of the button.
